note: Exploratory and failed runs are disclosed here and are not counted as acceptance passes.

failures.observed: Fixture MariaDB started through a child PowerShell was terminated when that shell exited; runner reported connection refused.
failures.resolution: Restarted the existing verified datadir as a persistent background process. No data loss; schema check passed.

failures.observed: Batch 6 fixture used program key bs_computer_science, which is a seeded legacy value but not in the academic catalog (422).
failures.resolution: Use catalog program bsit (unit amt, 4 years).

failures.observed: IERB entry creation sent group "" which overrides groupId; server correctly requires a group for new IERB records.
failures.resolution: Send __create__ on schemas 11-12; on 13+ verify Save stays disabled without a group (creation path intentionally unavailable).

failures.observed: Legacy-ID save used seeded Student 5, whose stored group fails cohort validation independently of the ID rule.
failures.resolution: Model a historical record precisely: set an alphanumeric ID on a Batch 6 fixture Student, then verify unchanged-ID save succeeds and a changed alphanumeric ID is rejected.

failures.observed: Admin hover sidebar backdrop intercepted clicks.
failures.resolution: Dismiss the sidebar like existing suites (pointer move + Escape).

failures.observed: Blocked-letter message was cleared by the next valid keystroke, by design.
failures.resolution: Assert the message immediately after the rejected characters, then assert digits-only result.

failures.observed: Page-level selection wait timed out (row checkbox count differed from assumption).
failures.resolution: Select the two synthetic documents explicitly and wait for the selected count.

failures.observed: Row action menu item intermittently not visible while the list re-rendered after search.
failures.resolution: Shared helper waits for the list to settle and retries opening the menu.

failures.observed: Gate refresh re-ran Student ID validation and cleared the transient blocked-paste/blocked-key notice.
failures.resolution: Messages have a kind; validation refresh never clears a notice; the next user edit does.

failures.observed: Dark-theme navigation rule out-specified the Adviser accent, so Student and Adviser active links matched in dark mode.
Top-border role accent was overridden in dark mode and drew an arc on the pill-shaped navbar.
failures.resolution: Removed the border accent; role is conveyed by the active link color, role chip text/icon and hero gradient.

failures.observed: Repeated exploratory runs exhausted the synthetic sandbox login limiter (60 per 15 min per IP), producing 401 in the base runner.
failures.resolution: Cleared counters in the synthetic sandbox storage only before each run; product limiter unchanged.

failures.observed: Required asterisk rendered on its own line in labels laid out as grid/flex columns (academic selects).
failures.resolution: Marker joins a wrapper around the label text that precedes the control.

failures.observed: Role chip was hidden below 600px and the profile button shows only initials, removing the non-color role cue on phones.
failures.resolution: Icon-only chip on phones with distinct icon shapes; text kept for screen readers; asserted at 390px.

failures.observed: Single-document deletion dialog stretched almost full width on the Documents page at desktop widths.

Final chain attempt 1: Batch 5 suite failed ("Formally submitted but unaccepted document is not counted as Accepted") because its own earlier run left 12 synthetic document_returned_for_revision audits for batch5-order-a (written 08:12, before this session) and never removed them. Reproduced on an isolated re-run; diagnostic showed state Returned for Revision.
failures.resolution: Batch 5 module now removes only its own batch5-order-* synthetic audits before and after use, and honors PRISM_TEST_EVIDENCE_DIR (it previously overwrote PRISM_V14_BATCH_05_EVIDENCE). Chain resumed from the Batch 5 step.

failures.observed: The shared documents-fixture cleanup rolls schema 13 back, which would break a schema-15 Batch 6 run.
failures.resolution: Batch 6 removes only its own enrollment rows and never changes the fixture schema.
